results.title: AI Agent Pricing 2026: Real Costs Revealed (Full Breakdown)
results.snippet: For most businesses exploring AI automation for the first time, a subscription model offers the clearest path to controlling AI agent pricing. Usage-based pricing works well once you have a reliable baseline of interaction volume to model against. Short answer: Beyond the sticker price, AI agent costs are inflated by integration and setup fees, per-conversation or per-token usage charges, maintenance retainers, and premium support.
